summary: BioMar anticipates an improvement in raw material supply and pricing conditions in the coming period. The company's outlook reflects expectations for market stabilization after previous supply disruptions affecting aquaculture feed production costs.
title: BioMar ser en kommende normalisering av råvaresituasjonen
title_en: BioMar ser en kommende normalisering av råvaresituasjonen

summary: Antonios Chalaris has departed BioMar to join Devenish, a competing aquaculture nutrition company. The article reports on staff transitions within the aquaculture feed sector, including Eli Hollon's move to Northern Wind (an unrelated company).
title: Eli Hollon joins Northern Wind; Antonios Chalaris leaves BioMar and joins Devenish
title_en: Eli Hollon joins Northern Wind; Antonios Chalaris leaves BioMar and joins Devenish
